body.name: one-dimensional multiplier score hull
body.construction: Evaluate the ridge-totalized score \(\mathfrak q_n\) and its derivative on every sample, use Gaussian multipliers to calibrate the one-sided supremum over \(K\), and invert the same studentized inequality for every \(\theta\in K\) to obtain \(C_n\). The output may be empty, but it is always a closed subset of \(K\).
